label: Dynamic Light Probe Detect (Recommended)
tagline: Probe reads each scene coordinate & shifts genre lens automatically
description: The Light Probe dives into each pocket of time, evaluates immediate emotional tension, and selects the matching genre lens (S01–S18) dynamically.

label: S01: Shrine / Slice-of-Life
description: Grounds every beat in tangible physical routine, acoustic calm, and subtle emotional shifts under the surface.

label: S02: Civilizational Collapse
tagline: Systemic decay, supply breakdown, infrastructure failure
description: Physicalized scarcity, collapsing logistics, institutional entropy, and lived survival pressure.

label: S03: Cosmic Sci-Fi
tagline: Vast scale, technological hum, existential vertigo
description: Acoustic void, mechanical resonance, cold vacuum, and the immense weight of deep-space reality.

label: S04: Fantasy / Mythic
tagline: Ancient weight, tactile vows, irreversible consequences
description: Grounded physical magic, worn stones, binding oaths, and the material consequences of power.

label: S05: Romance / Emotional Drama
tagline: Subtext-heavy, what remains unsaid, tactile proximity
description: Nervous micro-actions, charged silences, physical distance, and defensive emotional choreography.

label: S06: Psychological Thriller
tagline: Defensive cognition, paranoia, high-tension blind spots
description: Real-time fragmented thinking, calculating survival, perceptual blind spots, and coiling dread.

label: S07: Horror / Slow Dread
tagline: Uncanny details, atmospheric pressure, coiling dread
description: Visceral bodily discomfort, wrong acoustic pitches, escalating ambient menace without cheap jumps.

label: S08: Action / Kinetic
tagline: Physical momentum, impact physics, staccato beats
description: Spatial awareness, bodily impact, breath control, adrenaline response, and rapid kinetic cadence.

label: S09: Systemic
description: Supply chains, regulatory squeeze, currency velocity, and systemic friction grinding down individual souls.

label: S10: Coming-of-Age
tagline: Identity friction, boundary crossing, raw vulnerability
description: The physical discomfort of growth, disillusionment with adults, and testing limits in an unforgiving world.

label: S11: Underground / Street
description: Scent of alley exhaust, illicit transactions, alert eyes tracking exits, and survival pragmatism.

label: S12: Historical Testimony
tagline: Documentary gravity, material evidence, sober truth
description: Weight of real-world physical evidence, sober voice of lived witness, and strict chronological integrity.

label: S13: Comedy / Absurdist
description: Dry observational timing, straight-faced reactions to systemic madness, and sharp dialogue irony.

label: S14: Supernatural Slice-of-Life
tagline: The everyday mundane rubbing against the eerie
description: Routine domestic tasks happening right alongside inexplicable otherworldly anomalies.

label: S15: Civilizational Witness
tagline: Observer of monumental historical shifts & collective scars
description: Long-arc perspective, documenting irreversible shifts across generations and working-class populations.

label: S16: Military / Survivor
tagline: Tactical discipline, physical exhaustion, command tension
description: Rations, equipment maintenance, blistered boots, chain of command tension, and combat aftermath.

label: S17: Mystery / Unknown World
tagline: Investigative tension, clue accumulation, eerie secrets
description: Close inspection of anomalous artifacts, unanswered questions, and following causal chains.

label: S18: Collective Memory
tagline: Layered timelines, oral testimony, ancestral echoes
description: How shared trauma and working-class lore echo through songs, habits, and community architecture.
